description: Deterministic release-gate contract for the PetTripFinder Charleston market through PTF-CHARLESTON-SC-REGISTER-RESEAL-AND-AUTHORIZATION-PREP-002. Every number is derived from THIS market's committed authority by release_contracts.derive_authority; none is typed and none is inherited from or comparable to another market's contract.

deployment_authorization.means: A passing contract means this market's assembled package is STRUCTURALLY deployable: its authority files agree, its routes match its reviewed inventory, no held identity leaks, and every publish gate holds. It is not a deployment authorization and asserts nothing about the market being complete -- 58 of this market's 186 registered identities are still unresolved, and no founder deployment decision exists for Charleston at 84 published profiles.

identity_census.note: 186 registered identities, built from zero by PTF-CHARLESTON-SC-PARALLEL-SOURCE-READY-001 at $0 and no paid provider call, registered by PTF-CHARLESTON-SC-REGISTER-RESEAL-AND-AUTHORIZATION-PREP-002. Membership is this market's own corridor postal partition (census_membership_basis CORRIDOR_REGISTRY): a multi-core historic, airport, interstate and coastal market of 14 corridors over 36 postal codes -- the Historic District, the Upper Peninsula, West Ashley, North Charleston / Hanahan, the CHS airport and Convention Center district, Mount Pleasant / Patriots Point and Daniel Island (CORE); James Island, Summerville, Goose Creek and Ladson (CORRIDOR); Folly Beach, Isle of Palms / Sullivan's Island and Johns Island (FRINGE). Kiawah Island and Seabrook Island are OUTSIDE by their own stated municipality inside 29455 and preserved for a future kiawah-seabrook-sc market; Moncks Corner, Awendaw, Ravenel, Edisto, Walterboro, Beaufort, Hilton Head, Bluffton, Georgetown and Myrtle Beach are named and refused. Address-key collisions publish both hotels only under same-campus rulings in identity_resolutions.json. Rows the identity graph did not admit are recorded, not dropped: 2 DUPLICATE_LISTING; 27 IDENTITY_REVIEW_REQUIRED; 55 NAME_ONLY_UNRESOLVED; 45 NON_LODGING; 123 OUTSIDE_MARKET; 2 SAME_CAMPUS_DISTINCT_ENTITY.

reconciliation.note: 84 clean pet-friendly and 44 clean verified-no-pets over a 186-identity census. A row publishes only on an OPERATIVE first-party quote from the property's own page, bound to its census identity by the street identity that page states: a fee, a weight, a count, an amenity chip or a service-animal sentence alone publishes nothing. 21 reads were made and did not publish (13 CENSUS_ROW_NOT_ADMITTED; 4 POLICY_NOT_FOUND; 1 QUOTE_NOT_OPERATIVE; 3 SERVICE_ANIMAL_ONLY); every one is named in charleston_sc_clean_authority_001.json with its class. No gate was lowered to preserve a count.

policy_package.note: The verified hotel identities are DERIVED from this package at assembly time via site_data.verified_public_hotels(); they are not restated here. Every record carries the exact operator quote for each published fact, the capture lane, and the sha256 of the document it was read from. No record here came through a paid lane: this market cost $0 and zero provider calls.

final_partition.note: The partition of record for this market, referenced by path and content digest so the whole-site assembler resolves it from THIS contract rather than from a table in its own source. Written from the committed file by release_contracts.final_partition_block; verified by market_partition_resolution: the file must exist, declare this market_id, hash to expected_sha256 and carry expected_count identities. Regenerating the partition means reissuing this block.

public_surface.held_hotel_exclusion: Every seed hotel this market owns that is absent from the committed package (not-published seed hotels: held/manual-review plus rows still pending evidence) must have NO public route and NO reference on any surface: hotel profiles, the hotels listing/category page, nearby-lodging cards on any page, the policy-comparison table, the sitemap, canonicals, internal links, and /go/ interstitials. This market currently holds none -- every seed row it owns is published -- and the gate is derived, so it starts enforcing the moment that changes.

routes.note: route_mode market_prefixed: this market's hub, corridor and policy-comparison pages live under /pet-friendly-hotels/charleston-sc/. 7 of 14 corridors reach their own publication minimum; the rest are suppressed, which is a threshold and not a gap. The market and its corridors are hidden from navigation and the sitemap (show_in_navigation=false, show_in_sitemap=false) until a launch order says otherwise.

publish.note: The publish root must contain ONLY the static website plus the two Netlify control files. Build-internal reports the generator emits (_build_report.json, _broken_link_report.json, _quality_report.json, bundle_manifest.json) are read for gating but are excluded from site/ and must never ship.
